issues: The same or potentially continuous protagonist is fragmented into Arya, Orph, Rogue, girl and other generic labels without identity-resolution evidence.
Organizations/objects such as Iron Fang Pact and Moonstone are stored as characters.
Generic roles Father, mother, princess and Alpha are reused across episodes without stable entity provenance.
EP2 static-frame roles such as guardian, threat and mother are marked verified despite no audio or action sequence.

Cliff/snow/infant conflict aligns visually; Elena–Cora mother-daughter relationship is a direct factual error.
System misses golden serpent/infant rescue as a main plot/highlight and asserts unsupported Arya–Killen kinship.
Pendant/origin quest is plausible, but malformed ASR creates Orph identity and bloodline claims; visual spectral-wolf event is underrepresented.
Forest confrontation and kill order align; identities/relations remain vulnerable to non-diarized ASR.
Forest-to-crystal continuity aligns, but 'sole heirless' is mistranslated and actual whip fight 41.7–57.2 is not selected as highlight.
Crystal interaction and later dialogue are present, but mother claim remains speaker-unresolved; golden closing cracked-crystal high point is only partially covered by a broad candidate.
Cracked stone and war alert align; Tiffany negation is reversed, changing causal interpretation.
Assembly, hut exchange, bundle and parents quest align; speaker/kinship assignments remain non-diarized and some causal statements exceed evidence.
